description: Brief description of role and responsibilities.
Built a modern digital invitation platform with a responsive interface, emphasizing usability, elegant design, and seamless user interaction.
Designed and developed an internal company profile web application with meeting room booking, role-based access, and database integration to support operational activities across divisions.
Developed a web-based internship management system using Laravel, Filament, MySQL, and Tailwind CSS to streamline intern data administration across DAOP V Purwokerto.
